data.name: Plant Companion
data.description: The treesinger forms a close bond with a plant companion.  This plant is a loyal companion that accompanies the treesinger on her adventures. Except for the companion being a creature of the plant type, drawn from the list of plant companions, this ability otherwise works like the standard druid's animal companion ability.
